tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /snying thig gi bdud rtsi phyag mchod bzhugs so:

rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i lag mchod bya ba ni: thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba mdun du bzhag la: sems gsum sngon du btang la: g.yon pa'i srin lag gis chang la gtugs la: g.yas pa'i lag mthil du chos skor du mu khyud gnyis kyi bar la pad ma 'dab bzhi: lte ba la rang ngos nas chos 'byung chos skor du bri: dbus su hrī ma zhes brjod la thigs le gnyis brtsegs byas la rta phag yab yum du krong bskyed: sor mo'i ngos nas zla gam gsum la oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod la thig le re bya: de sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo krong bskyed: pad 'dab bzhi la rang ngos shar du ra ha zhes brjod la thig le gnyis brtsegs: rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum du krong bskyed: lhor tsa ri zhes brjod la thig le gnyis brtsegs rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum du krong bskyed: nub tu hrī ni zhes brjod pas thig le gnyis brtsegs pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum du krong bskyed: byang du sa ya zhes brjod pas thig le gnyis brtsegs las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum du krong bskyed: de nas chang gi steng du kha sbub la oṃ āḥhūṃ hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya sa ma ya staṃ: zhes brjod pas: yab yum rnams sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang sems dkar dmar babs pas thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres nas kha dog dkar dmar la ro mchog brgya dang ldan par bsams la: de nas lag pa g.yas gyen la bteg la: g.yon pa'i srin lag gis thod pa'i bdud rtsi blangs la: rang gi spyi gtsug gi bla ma yab yum: phyag mthil gyi gtso bo yab yum: sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo gsum: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams la tshar re 'bul: zhal du thim nas dges te gang 'dod kyi dngos grub ster bar bsam mo: de nas phyag mthil gnyis phul la gdong pa la phul te lha tshogs rang la thim par bsam rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bdud rtsi gsol: gzhan dam tshig gcig pa rnams la yang sbyin:

'di ni rtsa gsum phyi nang gi tshogs mchod ces bya ba: o rgyan pad+mas jo mo mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal la gdams pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: snying thig gi bdud rtsi phyag mchod/ PAGE - PAGE 95 -- PAGE 94 -
